An economist’s lens.
An engineer’s instinct.

I studied Economics at IIT Kharagpur. Today, I work at the intersection of business and AI: understanding the problem, designing the system, and getting it into production.

I enjoy the whole journey, from raw data and model behaviour to agent orchestration and the infrastructure underneath. The goal stays the same: build something useful that works in the real world.
